Q2 2025 review for Tomás Ferreira, APM, reports to me since Sept 2024. Talked Tue 8 July, 45 min, by the canal because the rooms were all booked.

## Context

Q2 was mostly Atlas: carrier booking page, carrier API v1, 14 warehouse interviews with Priya. He also covered the support rota for 3 weeks when Ravi was out.

## Strengths

- Carriers trust him. 31 carriers signed up for the pilot list, 19 of those through his calls.
- Interview notes are the best on the team. Priya said so unprompted.
- Calm in the Betriebsrat prep, did the Portuguese-English-German juggling with the Frío Turia folks without blinking.

## Where to stretch

- Saying no. He said yes to every carrier feature ask in May, I spent June undoing it.
- Written specs: too short. The rescheduling spec was 1 page, we needed 4. Pair with Sanne on the next one.
- After the offsite decision he went quiet for a week instead of disagreeing out loud. Told him I'd rather have the argument.

## Rating and pay

- Rating: 4 of 5, "exceeds" for carrier work, "meets" for specs.
- Raise 6%, from €58,000 to €61,500, from 1 August. Henk signed off 3 July.
- Promotion to PM: not this cycle, realistic in Q1 2026 if specs improve.

## Agreed for Q3

1. Own carrier API docs v2, incl. the backoff examples
2. Write the Waalhaven discovery plan himself, I review
3. Co-run one session at FreightTech with me? He said maybe, check by end of August, see [[Conference talk proposal]]
